description: The machine shape of godcode check --json: lexing and parsing a scroll without running it. Exit 0 when ok, 1 when diagnostics are present, 2 on usage error. Additive fields may appear in future; the fields listed as required never change meaning.

diagnostics.description: Every trouble found, empty when the scroll is pure

code.description: Stable machine code, e.g. LEXER_ERROR, PARSE_ERROR, FILE_ERROR

ok.description: True when the scroll is pure
